sub_problems.fills: CairnCommons/.gitattributes carries 'intentions-congruency-lab/** text eol=lf', so the lab checks out LF on every box and a recompile on a core.autocrlf=true box leaves the tree clean.
sub_problems.what: D1: append 'intentions-congruency-lab/** text eol=lf' to CairnCommons/.gitattributes with a comment citing this ticket; the merge-driver line stays.
sub_problems.why: Measured on yoga 2026-11-16 (2dda7060d84e's live fire, relayed by the orchestrator): with core.autocrlf=true the gate writes the lab LF over a CRLF checkout, leaving 98 of 131 lab files stat-dirty with an empty diff (--ignore-cr-at-eol: 0 changes). Every drain check and dirty=0 gate on a Windows box
